\begin{figure*}[t]
  \centering
  \includegraphics[width=\textwidth]{figures/fig_programs.pdf}
  \caption{Dependence graphs of two Qiskit programs. Nodes are operations, labelled with the source line
  that created them; edges are the dependences of the wire rule. (a,\,b)~Teleportation needs control
  dependence. The corrections on $q_2$ depend on the measurements through the green edges, which def-use
  ignores. (c,\,d)~A hardware-efficient VQE ansatz needs quantum dependence. The blue edges, where a CNOT
  changes its control, are missing from the classical PDG, whose slice of $q_0$ (bold) stops at $q_0$'s
  own rotations. Entanglement closure adds two rotations of $q_2$ that are not dependences (orange). $F$
  is the criterion's fidelity at $\ket{0\dots0}$. Graphs, slices and fidelities are computed by the
  study's code from the programs shown.}
  \label{fig:dependence}
\end{figure*}
